facts.text: The user wants more scientists and researchers to take the time to learn from indigenous communities.
The user believes indigenous communities are often pushed aside.
The user believes indigenous communities' knowledge is not given the recognition it deserves.
The user wants to change the attitude so indigenous communities' expertise is valued and integrated into modern scientific research and development.
The user wants indigenous peoples who share knowledge and expertise in scientific research and development to be properly compensated.
The user believes indigenous peoples should not be exploited.
The user believes indigenous peoples should receive benefits and recognition they deserve.
